summary.plain: The MAC detector at PEP: a large calorimeter of magnetised iron and detecting layers around the collision point, designed to capture all the energy of the particles from each e+e- collision.
summary.technical: MAC: large solid-angle electromagnetic/hadronic calorimeter, magnetised iron for muon momentum measurement, tracking drift chambers in a 5.7 kG solenoid and scintillator triggering.

technology.locator: W. T. Ford for MAC, "The MAC calorimeters and applications", summary
technology.quote: The MAC detector at PEP features a large solid-angle electromagnetic/hadronic calorimeter system, augmented by magnetic charged-particle tracking, muon analysis and scintillator triggering.
technology.value: Large solid-angle electromagnetic/hadronic calorimeter with magnetic charged-particle tracking, muon analysis and scintillator triggering
